review.gallery: Three verified building and apartment renders. The living scene from JRE matches the branded Leily factsheet. The same sources show neighbouring David material, a mirrored David pool view and a bedroom also in Wares marketing. Those reused assets and generic stock are excluded.
review.location: Leily-labelled map and six journey estimates checked visually in the factsheet. The leaflet does not identify an entrance or specific routes.
review.floorPlans: 66 residential drawings, six floor plates and five retail sheets. OCR on the visible title blocks checked against area component sums and sampled drawings. Page 18 range and page 68 roof unit R01 manually read. Page 72 prints 11ST. The retail sheets give the same indoor and total area, with outdoor area marked N/A.

unavailable: An exact entrance pin, verified driving distances and complete individually labelled penthouse drawings were not established in the accessible source pack.
